result.summary: The page is largely functional and visually coherent. One notable visual issue was found related to duplicate restaurant listings.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' entries side by side with the same delivery time (15-25 min) and delivery fee (€0.90). This looks like a duplicate data/rendering bug rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Investigate the data source or deduplication logic to ensure the same restaurant is not listed multiple times in the same carousel row. If these are genuinely different locations or branches, add a distinguishing label (e.g., branch name or address) to differentiate them visually.
